Editorial note This is a digital reproduction of “Conditional Relations, Voḷ II”, a translation of the second volume of the seventh and last book of the Abhidhamma—the Paṭṭhāna—by U Nārada, assisted by U Thein Nyun, which was ﬁrst published in 1981. While I tried to be as faithful to the original as possible, some changes were introduced: • Pāḷi terms were italicizeḍ • Abbreviations were expanded where space alloweḍ • A bibliography with links to archive.org—where available—was addeḍ • The Pāḷi-English Glossary at the end of Volume II was split between the two volumeṣ • The table of contents was moved to the front of the book. • Large and fold out charts were placed at the end of the book. The pagination of the original PTS edition can be found on the marginṣ Unless the page begins on a new paragraph, a vertical bar indicates the beginning of the new page. Please mail errors to verein@abhidhamma.de. Lots of thanks go to Josephine Tobin for the proofreading! Manfred Wierich Hamburg April 2020
